node.title: Re: print variable content
node.author: Eily
node.doctext:
There's the [doc://perldebug#Debugger-Commands|p command] that simply prints your variable as print would do. Or [doc://perldebug#Debugger-Commands|x] that displays the content of the variable, nested structures included. You can find those commands by typing h in the console. And you can learn more about the debugger in the corresponding [doc://perldebug|documentation] and [doc://perldebtut|tutorial].

Edit: Thanks to [haukex] and [johngg] for pointing out that I gave two links to perldebug instead of one to perldebtut :).
